headline: Last session: Sensex drops sharply as markets close today for Gandhi Jayanti holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, October 2, in observance of Gandhi Jayanti.
In the last session, benchmark equity indices faced sharp declines driven by heavy foreign institutional investor selling.
Higher global crude oil prices and global interest rate hike concerns continue to spark portfolio outflows.
Sticky domestic inflation and pressure on the Indian Rupee contributed to negative investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets remain shut today and trading will resume on Monday, 5 October 2026.
On the last trading day, Sensex tumbled over 570 points while Nifty dropped down to the 22,421 level.
Benchmark indices recorded an 8th straight week of losses, marking a extended weekly losing streak.
360 ONE Capital named Coal India and NTPC among its top stock ideas for October.
summary: Indian benchmark equity indices are closed today, 2 October 2026, due to Gandhi Jayanti and will reopen on Monday, 5 October. In the previous session, Sensex and Nifty extended losses amid significant foreign investor selling, sticky inflation, and high oil prices. Top stocks in focus include Coal India and NTPC following positive broker picks, whereas Bajaj Auto and Max Health featured among top weekly losers.
